question:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

PHMT, OGNU, NFOV, MEPW, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

;**Logic : **

 
• **First letter and second letter - (1) is subtracted from the position value.**
 
• **Third letter and fourth letter - (1) is added to the position value****​**​

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea0aa8099a47c211a946c949c307ebc100ddc8a0273233eced2a68ff2d8baf75.png] 

Hence, **"LDQX"** is the correct answer.
